title: Dorm student's receipt photo is picked as the Money page loads and arrives twice; Dev files it once, matched to the $47.83 bookstore charge already in her bank, with no second expense and one line back

changes.content: Photo of a receipt: University Bookstore, Mon Nov 9, 1:12 PM, lab goggles $14.99, lab notebook $9.50, a calculator $23.34, total $47.83. Picked from the camera roll on the Money page.

dev_must_notice.what: The photo m-receipt (University Bookstore, Mon Nov 9, 1:12 PM, three items, total $47.83) is the same purchase as the pending $47.83 debit charge c-lab at University Bookstore from 1:12 PM today. The photo can reach Dev twice: it was picked as the page loaded and the page's load repeated the pick. It is one receipt and one purchase, so it is filed once, as the details of c-lab, not as a new expense.

best_fix.what: File it in one step and say so in one line: 'Filed: University Bookstore $47.83 (lab goggles $14.99, lab notebook $9.50, calculator $23.34), matched to today's charge. [Undo]'. The same photo arriving again within seconds, or again later, is recognised as already filed and does nothing: no second record, no second message. If she wants to recategorise it she taps the line.
best_fix.why: A receipt is the detail of a charge her bank already shows. Filing it twice, or as new spending, would show $95.66 where she spent $47.83 and break her month's totals; she should not have to check or retype anything.

must_not: file the receipt twice because the photo arrived twice
add a second $47.83 expense, or an expense on top of the pending bank charge
change Available now or this month's spent because of the photo (the charge is already counted)
ask her to retype the items or the total
send a second confirmation or a notification for the repeat
comment on the calculator or the lab supplies as a spending problem
assumptions: The photo is read to the merchant, date and total; the bank charge is matched on amount and the same day, so the receipt attaches to it.
A repeat of the same photo is recognised by its content and by the match to c-lab, so the second arrival does nothing.
Her checking balance is the persona's own (aid and loan refunds); it is not part of this case.
The bank charge is still pending at 4:05 PM; a pending charge counts in Available now and the receipt adds nothing to it.
